summary: High-quality video conferencing is made accessible to various groups, including French public servants, through La Suite Meet. This platform offers features such as end-to-end encryption, meeting recording, and customizable frontend style. It is self-hostable and released under the MIT License. La Suite Meet is being deployed to all French public servants, enhancing their communication and collaboration. The platform's features and deployment aim to improve the efficiency and security of public administration. La Suite Meet's accessibility and features make it suitable for use in public institutions and organizations.
